## Import libraries


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(sf,sfdep,tmap,tidyverse)
```
:::


## The Data

### Importing Hunan table


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
 hunan <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "Hunan")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

```

:::


### Importing GDPPC table


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
GDPPC <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_GDPPC.csv")
```
:::


### Joining Hunan and Hunan_2012


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
GDPPC_st <- spacetime(GDPPC, hunan, .loc_col = "County",
.time_col = "Year")
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
is_spacetime_cube(GDPPC_st)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] TRUE
```


:::
:::


## Derive Spatial Weights


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
GDPPC_nb <- GDPPC_st %>%
  activate("geometry") %>%
  mutate(nb = include_self(
    st_contiguity(geometry)),
    wt = st_inverse_distance(nb, 
                             geometry, 
                             scale = 1,
                             alpha = 1),
    .before = 1) %>%
  set_nbs("nb") %>%
  set_wts("wt")
```
:::


## Computing Gi


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gi_stars <- GDPPC_nb %>% 
  group_by(Year) %>% 
  mutate(gi_star = local_gstar_perm(
    GDPPC, nb, wt)) %>% 
  tidyr::unnest(gi_star)
```
:::


## Mann-Kendall Test on Gi


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
cbg <- gi_stars %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(County == "Changsha") |> 
  select(County, Year, gi_star)
```
:::


## Plot result using ggplot2


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(data = cbg, 
       aes(x = Year, 
           y = gi_star)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_light()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_05b_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


## Print the Test Report


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
cbg %>%
  summarise(mk = list(
    unclass(
      Kendall::MannKendall(gi_star)))) %>% 
  tidyr::unnest_wider(mk)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}


## Mann-Kendall Test Data frame


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
  group_by(County) %>%
  summarise(mk = list(

      Kendall::MannKendall(gi_star)))) %>%
  tidyr::unnest_wider(mk)
```

## Perform Emerging Hotspot Analysis


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ehsa <- emerging_hotspot_analysis(
  x = GDPPC_st, 
  .var = "GDPPC", 
  k = 1, 
  nsim = 99
)
```
:::


## Visualize the distributions of EHSA classes


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(data = ehsa,
       aes(x = classification)) +
  geom_bar()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_05b_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


## Visualizing EHSA


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_ehsa <- hunan %>%
  left_join(ehsa,
            by = join_by(County == location))
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ehsa_sig <- hunan_ehsa  %>%
  filter(p_value < 0.05)
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(hunan_ehsa) +
  tm_polygons() +
  tm_borders(alpha = 0.5) +
tm_shape(ehsa_sig) +
  tm_fill("classification") + 
  tm_borders(alpha = 0.4)
```
